integrity: Analytic complete-class proof with reproducible exact-arithmetic finite consistency tests; no external validation or independent publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite connected simple cactus graphs with at least one edge. Graphs with overlapping cycles and arbitrary weighted root configurations are outside scope. Prior-work equivalence under other terminology remains a residual risk.
title: Parity-weighted Laplacian formulas for both canonical ellipsoids of cactus symmetric edge polytopes
